title: Rewards in play
legend-battles: if at least {share} of their event battles were for this clan
players-short: top {share} of players is place {last} or better, now {place}
clans-short: top {share} of clans is place {last} or better, now {place}
clan-short: clan in the top {share}: place {last} or better, the clan is {place}
no-clan: needs a clan in the top {share}
legend-members: for members in the top {share} of players
clan-battles: if they played {count} battles for this clan since joining it
footnote: By the event’s regulations, on the board as it stands. Every badge and medal also asks for battles played for the clan, which the game does not publish, so these are positions rather than awards.
